label: Refill seconds
description: Provisioning policy. Reconstructed on simulation restart.

label: Diversion improvement
description: Provisioning policy. Reconstructed on simulation restart.

label: Turnaround planning wait
description: Maximum simulated time an empty ship may retain a berth awaiting its arrival-time next-job plan. Unloading never waits for planning.

label: Exploration interval
description: Completed merchant departures between exploration voyages. The ship targets the nearest accessible port absent from its current market knowledge and may sell cargo already aboard. Applies on full simulation restart.

label: Initial port population gold
description: Explicit one-time population treasury grant per port in a new accounting session. Provisional Phase 2 tuning for funded procurement; never replenished.

label: Initial industry working capital
description: Explicit one-time working capital grant per manufacturing instance in a new accounting session. Provisional Phase 2 tuning for funded input purchases; never replenished.

label: Manufacturing worker revenue share
description: Provisional tuning default: 25%, not an approved design percentage. Share of an industry-owned manufactured-output sale paid to its parent port as worker income. The remainder stays with the individual factory. Zero disables the share; 100% is forbidden because the factory must retain revenue.

label: Investment enabled
description: Enable autonomous reviews. Disabling reviews leaves accepted material orders and projects intact. Provisional tuning; applies on full simulation restart.

label: Investment review interval seconds
description: Elapsed simulation seconds between reviews at each port. Provisional tuning; applies on full simulation restart.

label: Investment maximum report age seconds
description: Reject visiting ledger observations at or beyond this age; no remote live market reads. Provisional tuning; applies on full simulation restart.

label: Investment shortage persistence seconds
description: Required time between the first and latest distinct shortage observations. Provisional tuning; applies on full simulation restart.

label: Investment minimum observations
description: Required distinct, newer market observations; repeated copies of the same observation do not count. Provisional tuning; applies on full simulation restart.

label: Investment minimum shortage units
description: Minimum funded bid quantity minus advertised supply, and minimum bid depth above the estimated profitable price. Provisional tuning; applies on full simulation restart.

label: Investment reserve buffer days
description: Protect town consumption per day times this buffer times local reference prices, with the configured minimum reserve as a floor. Provisional tuning; applies on full simulation restart.

label: Investment minimum reserve gold
description: Minimum treasury reserve protected in addition to existing commitments. Provisional tuning; applies on full simulation restart.

label: Investment minimum surplus gold
description: Additional spendable gold required after protected reserve, construction material bids and working capital are funded. Provisional tuning; applies on full simulation restart.

label: Investment maximum pending projects
description: Limit accepted material-acquisition stages plus unfinished construction projects per port. Provisional tuning; applies on full simulation restart.

label: Investment maximum factories per port
description: Limit active manufacturing instances plus accepted acquisitions and construction projects. Does not change the starting-industry limit. Provisional tuning; applies on full simulation restart.

label: Investment maximum instances per type
description: Per-port limit for each manufacturing type, including accepted acquisitions and construction. Provisional tuning; applies on full simulation restart.

label: Investment minimum input buffer fraction
description: Fraction of configured input buffers required in observed supply after construction materials; startup purchases must fit working capital. Provisional tuning; applies on full simulation restart.

label: Investment minimum margin fraction
description: Required revenue margin above estimated cost recovery after the manufacturing worker share. Provisional tuning; applies on full simulation restart.

label: Investment material bid multiplier
description: Multiply each construction commodity baseline price by this ratio to cap funded material bids. Provisional tuning; applies on full simulation restart.

label: Investment maximum reports per port
description: Bound copied remote reports per receiving port; oldest received entries are evicted. Provisional tuning; applies on full simulation restart.
